title: Pulsar DL Flower Dry Herb Vaporizer
description:
The Pulsar DL Flower Dry Herb Vape offers smooth, flavorful vapor in a compact and modern design. Featuring a 1200mAh battery, this portable vaporizer is built for long sessions without constant recharging. Its ceramic heating chamber ensures even heat distribution for optimal flavor and efficiency, while multiple temperature settings give you full control over your experience. Perfect for at-home or on-the-go use, this device combines style, performance, and convenience in one sleek unit.

Key Features:
1200mAh Battery: Long-lasting power for extended vaping sessions.
Dry Herb Compatibility: Designed specifically for dry herbal blends.
Ceramic Heating Chamber: Removable ceramic airpath in mouthpiece.
Multiple Temperature Settings: Precision temperature control by 0.5°F increments (320-430°F).
Portable Design: Compact and discreet for easy travel.
USB-C Charging: Fast and convenient charging capability.

Specifications:
Type: Dry Herb Vaporizer
Battery Capacity: 1200mAh
Heating Chamber: Ceramic
Temperature Control: 320-430°F
Charging: USB-C
Color: Black
